successful_public_trace: Authenticated phone onboarding used the supervisor phone number correctly.
The agent recovered from a repeat_days=None error, selected the weekday Wake Up alarm, updated snooze_minutes to 5, printed the update response, and verified show_alarm returned 5.
Automatic no-answer completion supplied the missing printed Supervisor evidence and released the final.
failed_completion_findings: The followed-artist task found Eliana Harper but submitted 'Eliana Harper with 29 followers' rather than only the requested entity.
The Venmo task used host datetime.now/year, aggregated payment requests rather than actual roommate-filtered transactions, and submitted formatted $742.0; both logic and answer typing were wrong.
Nine episodes stopped after a single 30-second model timeout, most after one to three actions; no-identical-retry avoided waste but did not produce a decision.
decision: The mechanism generalizes independently but remains low accuracy. Test entity/numeric answer normalization, DateTime.now/contact semantics, narrower relevant-app authentication, and a single 60-second model cap. S3 on the S2 runtime remains useful repeat evidence; N must repeat S2/S3 before final spec/full validation.
